title: Rio Earth Summit (UNCED)
summary: From 3 to 14 June 1992 Rio de Janeiro hosted the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development. It adopted the Rio Declaration, the voluntary action plan Agenda 21 and a non-binding statement on forests, and opened the Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Convention on Biological Diversity for signature.

as_recorded.value: From 3-14 June 1992, Rio de Janeiro hosted the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development (UNCED).

importance.justification: The conference produced founding agreements for international climate and biodiversity policy.

sources.title: The Rio Earth Summit: summary of the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development (BP-317E)
sources.author: Stephanie Meakin
